trans-unit.target: TEXT_FESANX202_05520_SEQ_00<tab>The wandering minstrel regards you with a curious gaze. ※This quest is available for a limited time only.

TEXT_FESANX202_05520_SEQ_01<tab>Following the fireworks display, you inform the wandering minstrel about the mysterious vision you experienced. To your surprise, the man has an inkling as to the “enchanting concert” that was mentioned, and invites you to attend it with him. Thus do you make your way to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre in Old Gridania, where the concert in question is to be held.

TEXT_FESANX202_05520_SEQ_02<tab>Shortly after arriving at the amphitheatre, you are treated to a performance by a chocobo head-wearing pianist. The mellow musician turns out to be an esteemed predecessor of the wandering minstrel, and he gives you his heartfelt thanks along with words both enigmatic and encouraging. The melodies that reverberate in your heart will surely be your strength, and you look forward to the many adventures still to come.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_TODO_00<tab>Speak with the wandering minstrel in Gridania.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_000<tab>Still savoring the afterglow of the fireworks, are you? You look somewhat dazed, as if you have just awakened from a dream.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_001<tab>You actually <var 1A 02 /var>had<var 1A 01 /var> a dream, you say? And in it, you met an individual who bore an uncanny resemblance to me...
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_002<tab>While I know not the significance of your vision, I have an inkling as to this “enchanting concert” that was mentioned.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_003<tab>If you are otherwise unoccupied, would you care to attend it together?
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_004<tab>Excellent. Let us make our way to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre in Old Gridania at once.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_010<tab>It appears we have arrived during an intermission.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_011<tab>Do you see the piano on the stage?
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_012<tab>It is there for one and all to play during the Rising.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_013<tab>As young A'nimuili also knew, music is possessed of the power to comfort and inspire.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_014<tab>It can even restore faded memories to vibrant life, together with the emotions they once evoked.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_015<tab>With these wondrous effects in mind was the piano set up. 'Tis quite inspired, would you not agree?
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_016<tab>Ah, a performer has taken to the stage.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_017<tab>Th-This unmistakable arpeggio! Could it be...?
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_018<tab>This song is familiar to me. The performer could well be an esteemed predecessor of mine!
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_019<tab>There is only one way to know for certain. I shall go and speak with him after he has finished playing.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_020<tab>Apologies for the wait.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_021<tab>My suspicions were correct. Permit me to introduce to you the legendary composer...

TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_022<tab>...Nay, it isn't my place to reveal his identity. Not when he has gone to such lengths to remain anonymous, that he might simply delight in music with us.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_023<tab>Know, however, that you have been touched by his works, somewhere out there. This, I guarantee.

TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_024<tab>This <var 08 E905 ((woman)) ((man)) /var> is an aspiring adventurer. Might you have any words you would like to offer <var 08 E905 ((her)) ((him)) /var>?

TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_025<tab>This <var 08 E905 ((woman)) ((man)) /var> is an accomplished adventurer, and a renowned hero besides. Might you have any words you would like to offer <var 08 E905 ((her)) ((him)) /var>?
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_NOBINOBI_000_030<tab>Greetings, adventurer. Tell me─have you been enjoying the music that colors your journey?
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_NOBINOBI_000_031<tab>This question, I also pose to you over yonder.

TEXT_FESANX202_05520_NOBINOBI_000_032<tab>It is not only the battles and stories, or the music which brings them to life, but how you choose to interact with the game that truly shapes the experience.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_NOBINOBI_000_033<tab>For being part of this final-yet-unending fantasy, I give you my heartfelt thanks!
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_NOBINOBI_010_033<tab>As a token of my gratitude, please accept this gift.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_NOBINOBI_020_033<tab>Oh, and do remember the name “con TIKI.” It's a little project of mine.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_NOBINOBI_030_033<tab>Don't mention anything to our minstrel friend, though!
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_040<tab>It seems you are privy to a secret. But worry not─I am not one to pry.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_041<tab>Now then, enveloped in the warmth of enchanting music, I shall return to my wanderings.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_042<tab>After all, the adventure promises to continue for quite some time to come.
